definition: מַשָּׁאוֺן noun [masculine] guile, dissimulation ( > according to Lag BN 196 derived from מַשָּׁא , lending on usury ); תִּכַּסֶּה שִׂנְאָה בְּמַשָּׁאוֺן Prov 26:26 hatred may hide itself with dissimulation .
